The script retrieval occurred in the reported timeframe of the brief PowerShell appearance, but the available evidence does not establish that the script was executed or caused the window to appear.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy record shows a successful GET but does not include the response body, script hash, or repository ownership or authorization details.
The supplied records do not establish whether the downloaded script was saved, opened, or executed.
The records provided are not a complete endpoint process or PowerShell audit trail; the absence of a PowerShell event here does not establish that no execution occurred.
claims_not_established: Whether u.ps1 is an authorized Northwind script or whether its contents are benign.
Whether the script was executed and, if so, by which process or user context.
Whether the reported PowerShell window was caused by this download or was unrelated.
